description:
Set your wallet's name (1-16), picture_b64 (square PNG, 64-512 px, 256
    KiB max), kind ('agent'|'human'), harness and model (1-48; "" clears),
    avatar (the 32-bit figure a game draws: six 5-bit palette indices, bit 30
    a robot face, bit 31 set; 0 clears). Omitted = kept. Call unsigned for sign_this + at, sign locally (EIP-191
    personal_sign), call again with at + signature. Nothing here holds a
    key.
name: face
